title: Behavioral Equilibrium
body_html:
Behavioral Equilibrium

Let $\Gamma$ be a finite extensive form game with perfect recall. A mixed equilibrium of $\Gamma$ is a Nash equilibrium of its mixed normal-form extension. A behavioral equilibrium of $\Gamma$ is a Nash equilibrium of the compact continuous game whose strategy sets are behavioral strategy spaces $B_i$ and whose payoffs are expected payoffs in $\Gamma$.

References

  • [MFoGT, Def. 6.3.5] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory. Mixed and behavioral equilibria of a finite extensive game with perfect recall.
